title: Area Formulas
code:
Area of a Square: A = s²
Area of a Rectangle: A = l × w
Area of a Triangle: A = ½ × b × h
Area of a Circle: A = πr²
Area of a Parallelogram: A = b × h
Area of a Trapezoid: A = ½ × (a + b) × h

title: Volume Formulas
code:
Volume of a Cube: V = s³
Volume of a Rectangular Prism: V = l × w × h
Volume of a Cylinder: V = πr²h
Volume of a Sphere: V = 4/3 × πr³
Volume of a Cone: V = 1/3 × πr²h
Volume of a Pyramid: V = 1/3 × B × h (where B is the area of the base)

title: Pythagorean Theorem
example: In a right triangle, if the legs are 3 and 4, the hypotenuse will be √(3² + 4²) = 5.

title: Surface Area Formulas
code:
Surface Area of a Cube: SA = 6s²
Surface Area of a Rectangular Prism: SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh
Surface Area of a Sphere: SA = 4πr²
Surface Area of a Cylinder: SA = 2πr(h + r)
Surface Area of a Cone: SA = πr(r + √(r² + h²))

title: Angle Formulas
code:
Sum of Angles in a Triangle: 180°
Sum of Angles in a Quadrilateral: 360°
Sum of Angles in a Polygon: (n - 2) × 180°
